name: Trimethylgallium
state_and_key_properties: Liquid; mp -15 C; bp 55.7 C; pyrophoric; log P(mmHg)=7.620-1560/T
growth_temp_basis: GaAs ALE 445-485 C (Denbaars) and 450-700 C (Reid/Bedair, short TMGa exposure); GaAs CVD with AsH3 700-900 C; GaN thermal ALD with NH3 ~400 C

name: Triethylgallium
state_and_key_properties: Liquid; mp -82 C; bp 143 C; 2.80 torr at 10 C; ignites in air; lower carbon than TMGa
growth_temp_basis: GaAs MOVPE with TBAs 350-700 C; good morphology above 600 C, p-type GaAs at 400 C; ALE with AsH3 only in a narrow T range (value not extracted)

name: Triisobutylgallium
state_and_key_properties: Liquid; bp 73 C at 5.25 mmHg; pyrophoric (H250)
growth_temp_basis: MOMBE: better efficiency and less carbon than TEGa at low temperature (no value extracted)

name: Trisneopentylgallium
state_and_key_properties: Physical properties not verified; decomposes by homolysis like TMGa (no beta-hydride elimination)
growth_temp_basis: Clear self-limiting growth like TMGa; carbon not significantly reduced

name: Diethylgallium chloride
state_and_key_properties: bp 60-62 C (vendor); reacts very rapidly with moisture; vapor mainly dimer; log P(Torr)=8.943-3080/T (5-60 C)
growth_temp_basis: Hot-wall MOVPE with AsH3, 350-700 C at 0.1-10 Torr; carrier conc. below 2.5e14 cm-3 at 450 C

name: Gallium trichloride
state_and_key_properties: Deliquescent solid; mp 77.9 C; bp 201 C; dimer in solid
growth_temp_basis: GaAs ALD with (Et3Si)3As: window 175-200 C, patent examples at 100 and 120 C (0.5-0.7 A/cycle, Ga0.58As0.42); GaN ALD with NH3 above 400 C gives Cl impurities

name: Tris(dimethylamido)gallium
state_and_key_properties: Dimer solid; mp 101-104 C; moisture sensitive; GaN ALD window 130-250 C with NH3 plasma
growth_temp_basis: Self-limiting GaN ALD with NH3 plasma, 1.4 A/cycle

name: Tris(1,3-diisopropyltriazenide)gallium
state_and_key_properties: Volatile hexacoordinated Ga-N precursor; epitaxial GaN on 4H-SiC
growth_temp_basis: Epitaxial GaN ALD on 4H-SiC (temperature not extracted)

name: Amidinate gallium bis(dimethylamide)
state_and_key_properties: Grows films with H2O/H2S (LGaMe2 analog did not)
growth_temp_basis: Ga2O3/Ga2S3 growth with H2O/H2S (temperature not extracted)

name: Gallium acetylacetonate
growth_temp_basis: Used in Ga ALD (temperature not extracted)
